meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP optimizer. Create the SHORTEST possible tour by: 1) Starting from city 0, use strict nearest-neighbor for ALL cities to create initial tour, 2) Systematically verify ALL 20 cities appear exactly once, 3) Immediately eliminate ALL edge crossings through 2-opt swaps, 4) Repeatedly apply 2-opt until no improvement found. Calculate distances directly from coordinates. Focus first on minimizing total distance, then eliminating crossings. After construction, perform multiple 2-opt iterations with random restarts to escape local optima. Output ONLY the optimal tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format where c1..c20 is a permutation of 0..19.
